title: Analysis of Biomarkers of Inflammation as Diagnostic Tools for Mycobacterial Diseases
summary:
The diagnosis of tuberculosis (TB) or non-tuberculous mycobacterial (NTM) disease is based on the detection of bacteria. This detection is carried out from samples of the affected tissue, such as sputum, and can take up to 8 weeks. We want to change this.
In this project, we are looking for ways to detect tuberculosis or lung disease caused by non-tuberculous mycobacteria directly from blood. We plan to measure certain values in the blood of patients with mycobacterial disease. Then we will compare these values with those of patients with other lung diseases and with a healthy control group.
conditions: Sarcoidosis of lung with sarcoidosis of lymph nodes

interventions.name:
What is done within the scope of this study?
This prospective, non-interventional observational study involves the collection of venous blood samples from adult participants across five diagnostic groups to analyze inflammation-related serum biomarkers. Key biomarkers include matrix metalloproteina

II. Extrapulmonary tuberculosis (EPTB):
o Patients with a confirmed diagnosis of extrapulmonary TB.
o Patients who have already completed their TB-treatment are not eligible for this

III. Non-tuberculous mycobacterial pulmonary disease (NTM-PD):
o Patients diagnosed with pulmonary disease caused by NTM species according
to the ATS criteria

IV. Non-infectious inflammatory (lung) disease:
o Patients with a diagnosis of a non-infectious, inflammatory diseases mainly
affecting the lungs, e.g.: sarcoidosis, granulomatosis with polyangiitis,
organizing pneumonia, interstitial lung diseases, pneumonitis, vasculitis…

V. Controls:
o Individuals without known active infectious or inflammatory disease

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Participants must meet all of the following criteria to be eligible for inclusion in the study:
• Age 18 years or older
• Able and willing to provide written informed consent
• Belong to one of the following groups:
o Pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB)
o Extrapulmonary tuberculosis (EPTB)
o Non-tuberculous mycobacterial pulmonary disease (NTM-PD)
o Non-infectious inflammatory lung disease
o Controls
Exclusion criteria:
Participants meeting any of the following criteria will be excluded from the study:
• Under the age of 18
• Unable or unwilling to provide informed consent
